**Problem:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%.

**Actions taken:**

2. **Verified** the service is now healthy in all regions on v2.3.0, with error rate down to ~0.2%.

**Note:** v2.3.1 remains unhealthy in both production and staging per the deployment history — the on-call engineer (paged via the incident) should investigate it before any redeployment is attempted.
